ModuleName: Publishing a Course Website and Keeping It Current

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline listing the topics and subtopics covered in this module, used by instructors or learners to preview the scope of content on PreseMaker's publish feature, module index pages, content refreshing, site assembly, and ongoing maintenance.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to PreseMaker's Publish Feature
Artifacts.Description: An introductory reading that explains what PreseMaker's publish feature is, how it separates the authoring and delivery phases of course building, and how learners use it to access a fully assembled, navigable course website.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding Module HTML Index Pages
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains what a module HTML index page is in PreseMaker, how it serves as the dedicated web presence and landing page for each module, and why understanding it matters for authors managing a published course site.

Artifacts.Name: How Publishing Refreshes Module Content
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how PreseMaker's publish feature acts as a bridge between the authoring environment and the live learner-facing site, describing what triggers a content refresh and how edits made in the tool reach the published course.

Artifacts.Name: Assembling Modules into a Course Website
Artifacts.Description: A reading that describes how PreseMaker assembles individual modules into a unified course website, explaining the workflow step that brings discrete module units together into a complete, navigable published site.

Artifacts.Name: Keeping the Course Website Current
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the ongoing maintenance responsibilities after a course is first published in PreseMaker, covering why the site does not update automatically and how authors must re-publish to keep course content accurate and current.

Artifacts.Name: Keeping the Course Website Current
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate of the 'Keeping the Course Website Current' reading that explains post-publication maintenance in PreseMaker, describing the need for repeated publishing to reflect revisions, additions, or corrections made after the initial course launch.
